_comment: Web pages a learner has to visit. Captured by scripts/build/capture-web.mjs over CDP, annotated by scripts/build/annotate.mjs.

captures.name: github-pr-create
captures._comment: Lab 1.6 step 1: the Open a pull request form, with base and compare already filled in and the repository Pull Request template in the description. The head branch has to exist on the fork: run Lab 1.5 on it first, and never click Create pull request while capturing.

captures.name: github-actions-deploy
hideText: Upcoming change to GitHub App installation token format

captures.name: github-branch-rule
captures._comment: The integration rule that Set up my training environment creates. Its id changes whenever the rule is created again: read it with gh api graphql, branchProtectionRules { databaseId pattern }.

captures.name: github-new-branch
captures._comment: Lab 3.1 step 2: the New branch dialog of the Branches page, filled in for preprod from main. Nothing is created: the script never clicks Create new branch.

captures.name: github-pr-merge-squash
captures._comment: Lab 1.6 step 4: the merge method menu of an open Pull Request, opened from the arrow next to the merge button. Any open Pull Request of the fork will do: the menu is the same.
evaluate: (() => { const main = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => /^(Merge pull request|Squash and merge|Rebase and merge)$/.test(b.innerText.trim())); if (!main) return; main.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const caret = main.parentElement.parentElement.querySelector("button[aria-haspopup='true']"); if (caret) caret.click(); })()

captures.name: github-run-workflow
captures._comment: Lab 3.8 step 4: the Run workflow menu of the Org Monitoring workflow, in a monitoring repository made by an earlier run of the course. The menu is opened, never submitted.

captures.name: github-pr-check-failed
captures._comment: Lab 2.2 step 3: the sfdx-hardis comment of a US-021 Pull Request whose flow reads a field the package does not carry. Taken before the fix: the comment is updated in place afterwards.

captures.name: github-pr-flow-diff
captures._comment: Lab 2.2 step 3: the visual diff sfdx-hardis posts for each Flow a Pull Request changes.
evaluate: (() => { for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('body *')) { const p = getComputedStyle(el).position; if (p === 'sticky' || p === 'fixed') { el.style.visibility = 'hidden'; } } })()

captures.name: github-secrets-actions
captures._comment: Lab 3.1 step 5: where a fork keeps the values the CI reads. GitHub only ever shows the names, never the values, which is why the panel says not to close it.

captures.name: github-secret-new
captures._comment: Lab 3.1 step 5: the New secret form, filled in but never submitted. The value is a fake consumer key, typed by the capture script.
evaluate: (() => { const set = (el, v) => { const proto = el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ? HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype : HTMLInputElement.prototype; Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; const name = document.querySelector('#secret_name, input[name=secret_name]'); const value = document.querySelector('#secret_value, textarea[name=secret_value]'); if (name) set(name, 'SFDX_CLIENT_ID_INTEGRATION'); if (value) set(value, '3MVG9EXAMPLE.the.consumer.key.the.panel.printed'); })()

captures.name: github-pr-promotion-description
captures._comment: Lab 3.10 step 5: the description a promotion Pull Request is created with, the conflict warning, the promotionPullRequests block, the carried table and the folded prompt for a coding agent.
evaluate: (() => { const map = [[/nvuillam\/sfdx-hardis-training/g, "my-username/sfdx-hardis-training"], [/\bnvuillam\b/g, "my-username"], [/2026-09-24-1510/g, "2026-09-24-0930"], [/\[39, 40, 42\]/g, "[62, 63, 65]"], [/#39\b/g, "#62"], [/#40\b/g, "#63"], [/#42\b/g, "#65"], [/\b11f9887\w*/g, "7c41ab9"], [/\b258e3ec\w*/g, "d1e90e9"], [/\b181ab99\w*/g, "5b7e2c1"]]; const walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); const nodes = []; while (walker.nextNode()) nodes.push(walker.currentNode); for (const n of nodes) { let t = n.nodeValue; for (const [re, to] of map) t = t.replace(re, to); if (t !== n.nodeValue) n.nodeValue = t; } })()
(() => { for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('body *')) { const p = getComputedStyle(el).position; if (p === 'sticky' || p === 'fixed') { el.style.visibility = 'hidden'; } } })()
captures._fiction: The page is a real Pull Request of the maintainer fork; the numbers, the handle, the commits and the branch time are rewritten to the course fiction before the shot, the way the lab prints them.
